description: App-channel planning priors and rules derived from the PPL 2026 brief plus the June 2022-April 2023 MMM deck. These rules are for prototype reasoning, not final investment advice.

objective.budget_guardrail: Every pound needs to be spent with care; plans should show efficiency rationale and test risk separately.

channel_rules.planning_role: National reach, trust, draw-month storytelling and response bedrock.
channel_rules.mmm_note: MMM recommends reversing the drift from AV into Print/Digital. TV is the bedrock, DRTV has the strongest CPS, and final-week TV can overheat.
channel_rules.phasing_rule: Use across the draw month, with stronger support in first, second and penultimate weeks rather than over-concentrating in the final week.

channel_rules.planning_role: Local salience, Greater London opportunity support and community visibility.
channel_rules.mmm_note: OOH is not present in the MMM optimal channel table, so the prototype should treat it as a brief-led strategic layer requiring measurement design.
channel_rules.phasing_rule: Concentrate around priority geographies and tentpole windows rather than spreading thinly across all months.

channel_rules.mmm_note: Door drops are strong due to low cost per mailing; partially addressed is weaker on CPS; lapsed performs well but is constrained by available volume.
channel_rules.phasing_rule: Avoid immediate post-cutoff mailing. Use door drops heavily in the penultimate week and lapsed priority in the final week.

channel_rules.planning_role: Incremental video reach and controlled growth testing.
channel_rules.mmm_note: YouTube investment was too low for confident MMM conclusions and early evidence suggested worse-than-average CPS, so this should remain a test rather than a large default allocation.
channel_rules.phasing_rule: Use as measured test support around AV tentpoles and growth audiences.

channel_rules.planning_role: Intent harvesting and tactical response to demand triggers.
channel_rules.mmm_note: Generic PPC is reasonably good but limited in scalable scope; brand search is close to maxed out.
channel_rules.phasing_rule: Keep always-on coverage and add tactical upweights around EuroMillions/prize/news triggers and deadline windows.

channel_rules.planning_role: Audience growth, social proof, retargeting and creative learning.
channel_rules.mmm_note: Maintain but avoid over-weighting late week without separating prospecting and retargeting logic.
channel_rules.phasing_rule: Prospecting can work earlier in the draw month; warm audiences should rise nearer cutoff.

channel_rules.planning_role: Regional reinforcement, attention and efficient reach extension.
channel_rules.mmm_note: Radio CPS is steady and better than average; MMM recommends testing an earlier upweight before the penultimate week.
channel_rules.phasing_rule: Do not leave all audio to the final two weeks; test earlier-month support.

channel_rules.planning_role: Prospecting, warm retargeting and partnership-led digital value.
channel_rules.mmm_note: Prospecting should start two to three weeks before cutoff; retargeting is more effective nearer cutoff.
channel_rules.phasing_rule: Split cold prospecting earlier and warm retargeting later; do not treat display as one undifferentiated last-week pot.

brief_test_criteria.label: Hits the sample brief target frame
brief_test_criteria.requirement: Generated plan should balance to supplied 2026 budget and show whether forecast acquisitions clear 1,000,000.

brief_test_criteria.label: Uses MMM priors where available
brief_test_criteria.requirement: Channel rationales should cite the client MMM extract and identify any channel where brief demand exceeds MMM evidence.

brief_test_criteria.label: Responds to named brief priorities
brief_test_criteria.requirement: Plan QA should flag priority areas requiring explicit treatment: tentpoles, Greater London, July/Aug football context, May creative platform, channel role clarity and testing.

brief_test_criteria.label: Separates evidence gaps from confident recommendations
brief_test_criteria.requirement: OOH, YouTube/CTV and new partnership/free-ticket opportunities should be tagged as tests or measurement-led choices rather than treated as proven MMM recommendations.
